modelRouting.routingRationale: Two independent Rust foundations run concurrently; application and CLI convergence follow only after their concrete source APIs exist.

objective: Implement M1 only: one release-bound native Rust vertical slice shared by legion status, legion serve --stdio, one deterministic capability, one Arcane decision, and one typed receipt. Preserve all legacy runtime sources unchanged.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of primary checkout HEAD, index, validation, commit, and push; may not edit lane-owned files

interfaceLock.releaseBinding: legion_runtime::release_binding owns typed manifest parsing, full identity verification, VerifiedReleaseBinding, typed mismatch, and exact repair command legion setup --repair
interfaceLock.catalog: legion_catalog owns compact metadata loading and lazy capability-body resolution; metadata load performs no capability-body reads
interfaceLock.application: legion_application owns the shared M1 operation and typed status, capability, PolicyEvaluation/PolicyReceipt, and InvocationReceipt result
interfaceLock.mcp: legion_mcp is a reusable library and binary; initialize verifies binding before tool advertisement and the stdio session reuses one application instance
interfaceLock.cli: legion owns status and serve --stdio syntax and delegates without interpreter, shell, or child-Legion execution

ownershipAmendment.reason: Correct frozen M1 ownership for the reusable MCP library seam and place the vertical-slice test under a real Cargo package.

fileTouchPolicy.legacyPortInputs: All 524 legacy paths classified to M1 by migration/native-rust/m0/file-ownership-map.json are read-only behavioral sources during M1 and are not edit targets.
